notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix (none found for the conditional-phrase order at 85). §1985:VI.6.11.2 prints five formats: INTO with repeated {identifier-2 [ROUNDED]} (1), INTO or BY one operand then GIVING with repeated {identifier-3 [ROUNDED]} (2, 3), and INTO or BY one operand, GIVING one identifier-3 [ROUNDED], REMAINDER identifier-4 (4, 5); each ends with [ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1], then [NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2], then [END-DIVIDE]. Implemented at 85: the superset rule divideStatement parses the union and ArithmeticBinder.BindDivide narrows it to the five formats at every edition (COBOL1689, through GivingSendingOperand and Format1Receivers), and VersionConformancePass.VisitRoundedPhrase refuses ROUNDED MODE IS below COBOL-2014 (COBOL0803), the edition arm 1985 reaches. Probed at --std 85: all five formats compile and run with ON omitted, commas and END-DIVIDE; refused are a literal after INTO without GIVING, two INTO operands or ROUNDED on the INTO operand with GIVING, BY without GIVING, REMAINDER without GIVING, two GIVING receivers with REMAINDER, ROUNDED after REMAINDER, REMAINDER before GIVING, BY followed by INTO, and a repeated ON SIZE ERROR phrase (COBOL2269). PARTIAL for one arm: the printed sequence of the two phrases is not enforced. conditionalPhrases is a loop over conditionalPhrase guarded by ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates, which tests only that a format of the statement prints the phrase and that it is not yet written, with no edition arm for the order, so NOT ON SIZE ERROR written before ON SIZE ERROR compiles and runs at 85. §1985:IV.2.1 makes the sequence part of the format ("A general format is the specific arrangement of the elements of a clause or a statement."); either order is the 2002 change (§2002:F.2 item 33, which names DIVIDE), and the row's change record names it as what 2023 accepts and 1985 refused. The mechanism is the one grammar loop and predicate every statement with a conditional-phrase pair shares; the COMPUTE, READ, WRITE, REWRITE, DELETE and START format rows record it too. The witness runs all five formats in the printed phrase order.

next.reason: 1985: "identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ] … choice indicators: zero or more of the alternatives, each at most once, in any order". 2023 replaces ROUNDED with rounded-phrase, which adds MODE IS options. Its choice indicators also accept NOT ON SIZE ERROR before ON SIZE ERROR, an order 1985 refused.
